_type_options: Organization | LocalBusiness | Dentist | MedicalClinic | Restaurant | Store | LegalService | ProfessionalService | Person | ... (schema.org)
_description_hint: One sentence: what it does, for whom and where. Use the same sentence in the Instagram bio and the Google Business Profile.
_taxID_hint: Optional. Fill in only if you want it published in the schema (it shows up in the site code). E.g. CNPJ in Brazil, EIN in the US.
_address_hint: Optional. Leave street empty if there is no location that serves the public. Country as a 2-letter code (e.g. US, BR).
